- crates/jeeves/src/main.rs
- crates/jeeves/src/adminapi.rs (admin API — possible authentication issues)
- crates/jeeves/src/publicweb.rs (public web server — HTTP endpoints, potential injection)
- crates/jeeves/src/irc/mod.rs (IRC message handling)
- crates/jeeves/src/modules/host_fns.rs (host functions exposed to modules)
- crates/jeeves/src/db.rs (database — SQL injection)
- crates/jeeves/src/config.rs
- crates/jeeves/src/perms.rs
- crates/jeeves/src/backup.rs
- crates/jeeves/src/runtime.rs
- crates/jeeves-abi/src/lib.rs (ABI)
- build scripts (build-modules.sh, build-all.sh, test-all.sh)
- .mcp.json, .github/workflows/ci.yml (supply chain / CI)
